types.name: Aircraft
types.description: An airframe assigned to the squadron, as its maintenance data system records it.

properties.name: tailNumber
properties.description: The aircraft's tail number: its identity.

properties.name: unit
properties.description: Code of the unit the aircraft is assigned to.

properties.name: baseIcao
properties.description: ICAO code of the aircraft's base.

properties.name: missionCapability
properties.description: FMC fully, PMC partially, NMC not mission capable.

properties.name: deploymentLocation
properties.description: Forward deployment location; SECRET when populated.

types.name: MaintenanceEvent
types.description: A discrepancy or a piece of scheduled work recorded against an aircraft.

properties.name: tailNumber
properties.description: Tail number of the aircraft the event is against.

properties.name: eventType
properties.description: SCHED scheduled, UNSCH unscheduled, TCTO time compliance technical order, CANN cannibalization.

properties.name: workUnitCode
properties.description: Work unit code of the affected system.

properties.name: description
properties.description: What was found or what is to be done.

properties.name: closedAt
properties.description: When the event was closed; empty while it is open.

types.name: WorkOrder
types.description: A work order opened against a maintenance event.

properties.name: eventId
properties.description: The maintenance event the work order is for.

properties.name: technicianId
properties.description: Employee id of the assigned technician.

properties.name: createdAt
properties.description: When the work order was opened.

types.name: CrewMember
types.description: An aircrew member on the wing's roster.

properties.name: assignedTailNumber
properties.description: Tail number of the aircraft the member is assigned to.

properties.name: dutyStatus
properties.description: available, leave, or dnif (duties not including flying: medically grounded).

relationships.name: aircraft
relationships.description: The aircraft a maintenance event is against.

relationships.name: maintenanceEvent
relationships.description: The maintenance event a work order is for.

relationships.name: assignedTechnician
relationships.description: The technician a work order is assigned to. The column's comment names emp_id, but no foreign key enforces it.

relationships.name: assignedAircraft
relationships.description: The aircraft a crew member is assigned to, matched across the roster and MXDB by tail number.

sensitive.reason: dnif means the member is medically grounded, so a duty status can disclose a medical condition.

actions.name: ChangeDutyStatus
actions.description: Changes a crew member's duty status in the roster to available, leave or dnif.

findings.message: wrk_ord.tech_emp names a technician by emp_id but no foreign key enforces it, so a work order can name a technician who does not exist.
The roster's assigned_tail is an unconstrained string while MXDB's tail_no is varchar(9): tail numbers written differently in the two systems will not match.
The roster's unit query parameter most likely filters home_unit; confirm before relying on it as a filter.
depl_loc is SECRET only when populated; TypeSystem marks the field SECRET whatever it holds, which a reviewer should confirm is intended.
Nothing constrains closed_ts to be after opened_ts.
